## Hypit
Hypit gives AI agents (Claude Code, Codex...) a language and system to create video. Drop in a video, and your agent clones it as a complete workflow: footage, captions, B-roll and effects, all anchored to words instead of seconds.
**To be clear:** cloning a video is the fastest way in, not the only one. You can start from our templates, or just describe the video you want and your agent writes the workflow from scratch. Generation models are optional too: a workflow can compile captions, motion graphics and code-rendered visuals into a finished video without calling a generation model or incurring its service charges.
  SVML source on the left, with the corresponding video rendered live on the right.  
## Install once
```bash
npx skills add hypit-ai/hypit -g
```
This installs the Skill. On first use, your agent checks for the Hypit executable and helps prepare
it if needed. Your video project can live anywhere.
Hypit is free to use; your Coding Agent and model services have their own accounts and charges.
HypiHub is our recommended hosted model service. You can also use your own API or local models;
tell your agent the service name and API documentation so it can set up the appropriate connection.
[Agent environments and entry partners](./docs/guide/agents.md) ·
[Model and deployment services](./docs/guide/service-partners.md)

Moli 
   English  |
   简体中文  |
   日本語  |
   Deutsch  |
   Français  |
   Español  |
   한국어 
Moli is a production-ready headless browser for AI agents. Its on-demand layout
and rendering design combines a complete browser runtime with a lightweight
resource footprint.
Moli helps your AI agent fetch and extract web pages, search the web, and
automate browser tasks.
Use it through the CLI, CDP, WebDriver Classic, or WebDriver BiDi.
Moli supports Linux, macOS, and Windows.
## Quick start
Give this prompt to your AI agent:
```text
Install the skills under https://github.com/lexmount/moli/tree/main/skills,
follow their instructions to download and install the latest prebuilt Moli
binary, then use moli-webfetch to fetch https://example.com and show me the
result.
```
### Direct installation
On Linux or macOS:
```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL \
  https://github.com/lexmount/moli/releases/latest/download/moli-installer.sh | sh
```
On Windows, run in PowerShell:
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://github.com/lexmount/moli/releases/latest/download/moli-installer.ps1 | iex"
```
## Showcase
   An HTML5 game rendered by Moli and inspected live through Chrome DevTools. 
   rust-lang.org rendered by Moli, with its live DOM, CSS, and geometry available in Chrome DevTools. 
## CLI usage
### Extract a page
Render the page as Markdown with Moli's default completion strategy:
```bash
moli fetch \
  --dump markdown \
  --wait done \
  https://example.com
```
Or directly return a compact, model-friendly semantic tree:
```bash
moli fetch \
  --dump semantic_tree_text \
  --wait-selector body \
  https://example.com
```
For visual output, enable on-demand layout and write a viewport PNG, a full-document PNG, or a paginated PDF:
```bash
moli fetch --layout --dump screenshot https://example.com > page.png
moli fetch --layout --dump screenshot_full https://example.com > full-page.png
moli fetch --layout --dump pdf https://example.com > page.pdf
```
To export a page after an explicit interaction, combine `--eval` (or
`--eval-file`) with `--dump`. The expression runs after page readiness;
promises are awaited, and any pending navigation is followed before export.
Its return value is discarded without serialization. An exception fails the
command without emitting a dump.
```bash
moli fetch --eval 'document.querySelector("button.show-details").click()' \
  --dump markdown https://example.com
```
Only the supplied expression performs interactions. W

# DS Bot
English | [中文](README.zh.md)
DS Bot is an open-source project built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), available as a standalone desktop app or as a DSH plugin. It turns DSH into bots that you create, talk to and work with.
## Sponsors

Sign up now and get 40% off DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Exclusive perks for DS-Bot users: get $0.50 in credits when you sign up, earn another $2 after your first API call, and receive up to $10 in bonus credits when you top up! Try it now:  ModelGo Official Website  
## Install
**Desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux)**
The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you don't need to install DSH first. Download the installer for your system from [Releases](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/latest), open it, and set up a model in Settings (it can also copy your existing bot team from DSH).
If your system warns about an unsigned app: on Windows select **More info** → **Run anyway**; on macOS open **System Settings** → **Privacy & Security** and select **Open Anyway**.
**As a plugin in DSH**
First install DSH and set up at least one model in it. DS Bot uses the models from DSH.
- **DSH Desktop**: In the sidebar, select **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, enter `ds-bot` (in mainland China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**), then select **Install** and **Enable now**.
- **DSH Web** (needs Node.js `22.19` or later, and pnpm):
```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add ds-bot
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 web
```
**Docker (NAS, Linux server)**
See [`docker/README.md`](docker/README.md).
## Setup
I strongly recommend that you set up your other bots and group chats by just talking to a bot.
### Web search
DS Bot selects its `auto` search provider for the whole profile. If you disable `web-search-auto`, also select another registered search provider in that profile. See [Web search](ds-bot/README.md#web-search) and the [recovery steps](docs/known-issues.md#web-search-fails-everywhere-after-turning-off-web-search-auto).
## Features
### Bot
You can do all your talking and work with one bot, in one window. You don't need to worry about the context behind it. The bot's details page shows its info, and there you can pick the model and thinking level you want it to use. You can switch model

# SoduWork
## The AI-native engine for teams and their agents
**A chat ends with an answer. A SoduWork request ends when the person who asked signs off.**
**Multi-harness · Multi-agent · Self-hosted**
Works with Pi · OpenCode · DeepSeek Harness · Qwen Code · Kimi Code · Codex Harness · Codex
```sh
git clone https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork
cd SoduWork
```
| Platform | Start command |

| macOS / Linux | `sh start.sh --desktop` |

| Windows Command Prompt | `start.cmd --desktop` |
[Website](https://soduwork.ai) | [Live demo](https://soduwork.ai) | [Documentation](docs/README.md) | [Docs website](https://dev.soduwork.ai) | [Releases](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy)

## What SoduWork can do for you
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **One harness does the work, another reviews it** | Pick Pi to do the work. OpenCode, on a different model, reviews it against the acceptance criteria. If the review fails, the work goes back with the reasons. |
| **Hand a request to a colleague's agent** | People and AI work together: you file a request, AI writes the acceptance criteria, and you assign it to yourself or a colleague. The assignee's agent does the work and reviews it, and a person signs off. Everyone on the request can see who did what. |
| **Turn one person's know-how into a team asset** | When you and AI get a task right, save the chat as a plugin. After review, anyone on the team can use it and contribute improvements, with access granted as needed. |
## Core ideas
**🔀 Smart dispatch**
**The right agent and model for each job.**
- Pick a harness for each step and switch mid-conversation
- Routine steps on cheap or local models, strong models where it matters
- Long tasks go to your own cloud runner
**🛡️ Built-in governance**
**Your organization decides which AI does what, and where.**
- Plugins are reviewed before they are shared, granted to teams or people, and can be revoked
- Roles, usage, cost and an audit log
- Self-hosted
**✅ Verified delivery**
**Set the bar first. Done means the requester signed off.**
- Every request carries its acceptance criteria
- A separate AI review checks each one

agentes.chat 
  The open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together.  
   Website  ·
   Cloud  ·
   Self-hosting  ·
   Features  ·
   Discussions 
Agents join your channels and DMs with a role, an owner and a budget, work where everyone can see,
and ask before anything sensitive. They think with Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, Gemini, Grok or any
OpenRouter model, use MCP tools, and get a computer and a browser of their own. Self-hosting is
free and always will be (AGPL-3.0, no license key), or use agentes.chat Cloud, the paid, hosted
option: both run this same codebase. Changing it without publishing your changes, or reselling it
under your own brand? There is a [commercial license](COMMERCIAL.md).
## Why agentes.chat
- **One conversation for people and agents.** Agents are members of the workspace, not a sidebar
  bot: they read the channel, answer when it's theirs to answer, and hand work back and forth.
- **Safe by default.** Merges, deploys and anything a connector marks sensitive wait for a person's
  approval in the chat. Every model call is budgeted and recorded per agent.
- **Agents that actually do the work.** Their own computer, a real browser you can watch and take
  over, Claude Code and Codex, routines on a schedule or an event, memory that learns.
- **Yours to run.** One command on a Linux server, Postgres as the only dependency, web, desktop and
  phone apps that connect to your server.
An open-source alternative to team chat with bolted-on AI bots, and to single-player agent apps such
as Grok Bot, ChatGPT dots, OpenBot.run and OpenMausBot (all of which it imports from).
## Quick start
- **Cloud:** sign up at [agentes.chat](https://agentes.chat).
- **Your own server** (Linux):
  ```sh
  curl -fsSL https://agentes.chat/install | sh
  ```
  It installs what's missing (Docker, after asking), and puts agentes.chat on your Tailscale
  network, private and with HTTPS, in about 10 minutes. [SELF_HOSTING.md](SELF_HOSTING.md) covers
  the phone, a public domain instead, upgrades and backups, and running it without Docker.
Each organization adds its own model key (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.ai, MiniMax, Command Code or
OpenRouter) in the app.
